excluded.schema: The major version. A major that keeps this projection keeps identities; one that changes it is listed in majors.json, and its migration recomputes them.
excluded.caseSet: A pointer to the set that holds the case. The same case in another set, or in a renamed set, keeps its digest, so a case is traced by its digest across sets. The set's own digest covers its membership.
excluded.validation: The review status. Reviewing a case does not change what it asks or grades.

excluded.author: A pointer to a person, erased with them. Erasing it keeps the case's digest.

excluded.schema: The major version. A major that keeps this projection keeps identities; one that changes it is listed in majors.json, and its migration recomputes them.
excluded.description: Prose for people. Behaviour is pinned by models, parameters, prompts and factors.
excluded.label: A name for people.
excluded.informational: Values that do not decide behaviour, such as a provider fingerprint seen at resolution.

excluded.template: The text that `digest` pins. A configuration with the text and one without it are the same configuration; verifyConfiguration checks the text against the digest.
excluded.uri: Where the template was resolved from. Two resolutions of one template give one identity.
